factors.name: slope

factors.name: water_holding

factors.name: salinity

factors.name: sodicity

factors.name: gypsum

factors.name: carbonate

factors.name: fertility

factors.name: drainage

factors.name: water_supply

factors.name: temperature

factors.note: Plant-available water capacity: polygon mean 12.69 cm/m; rating 93/100 (severity 0); 0% of cells severity>=2; reversibility: partially_reversible; source: Saxton-Rawls PTF on SoilGrids sand/clay/SOC/CFVO (~250 m); computed pedotransfer estimate, not measured

factors.name: salinity

factors.name: sodicity

factors.name: gypsum

factors.name: ml_cultivation_likelihood
factors.note: probability that land with these terrain/soil/climate conditions is cultivated in Jordan today (spatially cross-validated LightGBM ensemble, isotonic-calibrated); NOT a suitability probability

label_basis.1: rule-derived (FAO-style limiting-factor evaluation) + ML cultivation-likelihood evidence; never field-verified
label_basis.2: rule-derived + ML evidence; includes land observed under cultivation in 2021 (observed, WorldCover+IO LULC)
label_basis.3: rule-derived: reversible/partially reversible severe limitation(s); feasibility NOT assessed here (see Model 2)
label_basis.4: rule-derived: irreversible limitation (steepness, stoniness, hyper-aridity <100 mm/yr, gypsic, temperature) or ML-unsupported
